name: Posle smerti prol'yotsya dozhd'
source:
Your academy receives a government grant! Now, the best students, including you, are joining their professors on an archaeological dig on a mysterious island, previously known as Ghost Island. Rumor has it that this island was an old mistake on maps, but it was recently rediscovered! And now it's up to you to explore this uncharted patch of land.

But buried in the island's depths, a witch awaits her rebirth, granting you a wish in exchange. All you need to do is sacrifice... a human. Will you risk fulfilling your cherished dream? Or will someone else take the risk first and outwit you all? Welcome to Witch Island.
translation:
你就读的学院获得了一笔政府科研拨款！如今，包括你在内的顶尖学生们正跟随教授一同前往一座曾被称为“幽灵岛”的神秘岛屿开展考古发掘。传闻这座岛屿曾是旧地图上的一处测绘谬误，直到最近才被重新发现！而探索这片未知土地的重任，如今便落在了你们肩上。

然而在岛屿深处，一名女巫正静候着自己的重生，并承诺实现你的一个愿望作为交换。你所需要做的，仅仅是献上一份祭品……一个活生生的人。你会为了实现梦寐以求的夙愿而铤而走险吗？还是说会有别人抢先一步痛下杀手，将你们所有人玩弄于股掌之间？欢迎来到女巫岛。
